name: Webex - Security Events
description: The Webex Security Events dashboard in Sumo Logic offers a detailed view of security-related activities within the Webex environment. It tracks changes in Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) status, remote access events, login activities, and authorization events over time. The dashboard includes sections for recent login and authorization code events, recent deactivated and reactivated users, and activities on allow and deny lists. Additionally, it provides insights into external admin additions and accounts assigned to external users. This dashboard enables quick identification of potential security issues and helps in proactive incident management.
title: Webex - Security Events
